"Live.|Micah's parents and Barriss Offee|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|female]] was the '''mother''' of the [[Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling|child]] [[Micah]]. During the [[Imperial Era]], they and [[Micah's father]] brought Micah to the [[Mirialan]] [[Barriss Offee]], known only as "the healer" who then instructed the two to take their child to an [[Barriss Offee's friend|old friend]] of hers to escape the [[Galactic Empire]]. Grateful for the assistance that Offee had given them, the couple inquired about how the family could repay her, but were simply asked to live. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The character was voiced by [[Suzie McGrath]] in "[[The Way Out]]." ==Appearances== *{{TOTE|The Way Out}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{InsiderCite|229|The Redemption of Barriss Offee}} {{Imo}} *{{InsiderCite|236|Tales of Destiny}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Madre de Micah |ka=მიკას დედა }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
